title: Totonaco del cerro Xinolatépetl Language (TQT) – L1 & L2 ...
text: Totonaco del cerro Xinolatépetl is a stable indigenous language of Mexico. It belongs to the Totonacan language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
